hook.es: Todas las conexiones empiezan a ser imposibles de seguir.
hook.en: All the connections start to become impossible to follow.

objective: The growing complexity of the Parallel World forces the creation of Moon, a central command view. The Traveler sees the whole map for the first time — and how much is still dark/unexplored.

metadata.call_to_action: Ver todo el mapa, por primera vez.
metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler standing before a floating map interface (Moon), most of it lit, large sections still dark

notes: Theme: the need for visibility/control once a system outgrows what one person can track by feel.
Emotional conflict: awe at how far things have come, mixed with the weight of how much is still unknown.
Visual motif: the map-with-dark-zones device, reused and paid off in Episode 10.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 07.
